run_depth_to_image_generation: run depth-to-image generation using a stable diffusion model on Habana Gaudi HPU with a base image and text prompt
generate_images_with_gaudi_pipeline: generate images from a base image and text prompt using GaudiStableDiffusionDepth2ImgPipeline with configurable schedulers
configure_diffusion_scheduler: configure a diffusion scheduler (DDIM, Euler, or PNDM) for the depth-to-image generation pipeline
save_generated_images: save generated PIL images to a specified output directory after running the depth-to-image pipeline
enable_hpu_optimization: enable Habana HPU acceleration with HPU graphs and bf16 precision for faster depth-to-image generation
